name: Callahan Intrastate Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Interconnect with Cypress Pipeline, western Nassau County
values.EndLocation: Interconnect with Peninsula Pipeline, Nassau County
values.Owner: Peninsula Pipeline Company; Seacoast Gas Transmission

researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row: no Callahan, Peninsula, Seacoast or Nassau name in the existing roster. The Chesapeake Utilities 10-K for 2020 says the 26-mile, 16-inch steel pipeline was built by Peninsula Pipeline and Seacoast Gas Transmission, each owning 50 percent, and went into service in June 2020. It was announced in May 2018. It connects to the Cypress Pipeline in western Nassau County and ends at the existing Peninsula Pipeline. Length is 26 mi, about 42 km, which meets the 25 km rule. One source only, the 10-K, so no second independent source; a Florida Public Service Commission or operator release would be a cheap second source. Intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected. Owner spelling for Peninsula Pipeline and Seacoast not on the team's alias list, check before staging; the parent Chesapeake Utilities Corp is an exact alias hit. Seacoast parent not confirmed. Route not researched; no public GIS found yet. Capacity and cost not stated in the source. Peninsula Pipeline system row is a separate candidate and should not absorb this line.
